recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition featuring three overlapping female portraits framed within a rounded-corner rectangle, topped by a horizontal header split into solid black and textured red sections with contrasting typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The three portraits overlap from left to right, creating depth and a sense of unity.
The rounded-corner lime green frame separates the main imagery from the header.
The header is bifurcated into a solid black left side and a floral-textured red right side.
Minimalist line-art daisy icons are scattered across the composition to unify the theme.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects occupy the lower 80% of the frame, scaled to fill the width with varying degrees of profile and front-facing views.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central subject's gaze and the sharp vertical line dividing the header.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bold white text on the top left, across the header to the right, then down into the faces following the overlap from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is tightly packed with subjects and graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm skin tones and hair shades (blonde, brunette, auburn).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and vibrant red in the header section.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Lime green for the internal frame and mustard yellow for secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast in the header; naturalistic but warm saturation in the photographic portraits.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to one primary red and one primary green accent

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses varying heights and baseline shifts for a playful, rhythmic feel.
Secondary text uses wide tracking and uniform caps.
Lowercase 'e' characters are often smaller and elevated within the word.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'e' is reduced in scale and vertically centered against full-height capitals.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, irregular display face paired with a clean, wide-tracked geometric sans for balance.
graphicDevices: Floral texture overlay on red background

preserve: The wide tracking of the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the geometric foundation for the display text.
Matches the subtitle's airy, modern geometric feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of three women with different hair colors (blonde, brunette, auburn) overlapping each other in a triptych-style arrangement. Place them inside a lime-green rounded-corner frame. Above the frame, create a horizontal bar split into solid black on the left and a red section with subtle floral patterns on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in the black section using a bold sans-serif with the 'e' characters smaller and raised. Add the subtitle in the red section using a wide-tracked geometric sans-serif in white and yellow. Overlay 2-3 thin black line-art daisy icons across the corners.

verificationChecks: Is the 'e' in the main title smaller than the other letters?
Is the frame's corner radius consistent?
Is the subtitle tracking significantly wider than the title?
Does the red section have a visible floral texture?

mustRedesign: Avoid using the exact band name or album title
Do not replicate the specific faces of the original artists
Ensure the daisy line art is a generic vector illustration

mustAchieve: Clean, graphic separation between header and image

postGenerationChecks: Check for correct baseline shifts in display text
Verify the lime green frame is fully visible
Ensure the three faces are distinct but unified
Confirm the red background texture does not obscure the text
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Overlapping Portrait Triptych] + [Rounded Frame] + [Split Header with Mixed Sans-Serif Typography] + [Minimalist Floral Line Art].
